subject.title: fix(control-ui): increase chat history limit from 100 to 500

question: Should Control UI accept a 500-message fixed initial history window for this issue, or require load-older pagination that keeps the initial payload bounded?
rationale: Both paths can expose older messages, but the fixed-window PR changes the default payload/render size while current docs and protocol shape point toward bounded initial history with pagination as the safer UX/performance model.

options.title: Require load-older pagination
options.body: Keep this PR paused or close it after a viable pagination path becomes canonical, preserving the bounded initial history behavior.

options.title: Accept fixed window after repair
options.body: Allow this PR to proceed only after all request tests are updated and real Control UI proof shows the 500-message behavior works acceptably.

recommendation.title: Require load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep this PR paused or close it after a viable pagination path becomes canonical, preserving the bounded initial history behavior.
